items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: The name 'Chi-chi' is mentioned only by the [INTERVIEWER] in a question ('Chi-chi — I think is thank you, isn’t it?'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge the name, nor does he mention it elsewhere in the provided text.

ctx.x: No, see, because I set you up.
Chi-chi — I think is thank you, isn’t it?

But you see what I’m saying though? And like if a kid sees something, and you show it to him, and he can do it slowly, and — oh, I see that. It’s simple. They call it the light bulb going on. And I always say this, like I’ve been kind of fortunate, because if I explain something to you this way and you don’t get it, I can explain it four, five, six different other ways, like I think I can, because I’ve been pretty fortunate I’ve been able to do that. Because I hate for someone to come to me for someone, and I’m…
